workflow.name: Example 04 - System Health Observatory
workflow.description: Five parallel local system checks, configurable findings, and a verified diagnostic archive. 45 activities spanning 16 activity types.

data.label: 07  REPORT PACKAGE  /  FOLLOW THE FLOW LEFT

config.description: Review local system metrics and bounded error events; write a verified report package.

config.query: SELECT CSName, Caption, Version, TotalVisibleMemorySize, FreePhysicalMemory FROM Win32_OperatingSystem
SELECT Name, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors FROM Win32_Processor
SELECT DeviceID, Size, FreeSpace FROM Win32_LogicalDisk WHERE DeviceID='{{paths.param.systemDrive}}'

config.message: System volume {{disk.param.DeviceID}} | Free: {{disk-value.param.result}}% | Report directory exists: {{workspace.param.exists}}

config.query: SELECT Name, State FROM Win32_Service WHERE StartMode='Auto' AND State<>'Running'

config.message: EventLog: {{event-service.param.status}} | RPC: {{rpc-service.param.status}} | WinRM: {{winrm-service.param.status}} | Stopped auto services: {{auto-services.param.count}} (informational).

config.query: SELECT Description, DHCPEnabled FROM Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration WHERE IPEnabled=True

config.message: IP-enabled adapters: {{network.param.count}} | Firewall service: {{firewall.param.status}} | Restart flags: servicing={{cbs-reboot.param.exists}}, updates={{wu-reboot.param.exists}}.
Errors: {{errors.param.result}} | Critical: {{critical.param.result}} | Limited selection: {{events.param.eventTruncated}} | Time zone: {{timezone.output}}.
No configured review condition matched on {{os.param.CSName}}. See the report for scope and measurements.

config.content:
SystemReport.txt summarizes review findings. Findings.json contains measurements and grouped events.
The workflow collects local information and writes this package; it does not modify system configuration.
Clear means no configured review condition matched. Review indicates findings to inspect.
The ZIP is extracted and all three files are verified against their originals using SHA256.
The output folder and verification copy remain on the server and may be removed after review.

data.label: Note
data.text:
SYSTEM CHECK

Five parallel checks collect platform, storage, service, restart and event information from the NodePilot server. The assessment applies the configured thresholds and records findings.

data.label: Note
data.text:
REPORT & VERIFICATION

The selected outcome continues into the report lane below, flowing from right to left. A text report, JSON findings and a package guide are archived, extracted and compared using SHA256.

Each run writes to a new temporary directory. System configuration is unchanged.
